title: Boot UI: setup finishing and the dashboard appearing now cross-fades
description: The single most jarring beat in the whole first-launch experience: RootView's Group{if setup.stage == .ready {ContentView()} else {SetupView()}} had zero animation at all - the boot screen cut instantly to the dashboard with no transition. Fixed with .transition(.opacity) on both branches and .animation(value: setup.stage) - no withAnimation needed anywhere else since Stage is already Equatable.
commit_message: Cross-fade from the boot screen into the dashboard
